           CAINCA

         Brazilian Plant-Chiococca

        (CAHINCA)


This remedy has been found of use in dropsical affections. Its urinary
        symptoms are well marked. Albuminuria, with dyspnœa on lying down at night. Ascites and
        anasarca, with dry skin.



Urinary.--  Constant desire to urinate. Polyuria while
        travelling. Urine fiery. Burning pain in urethra, especially glandular portion.



Male.--  Drawing in of testicles and spermatic cord. Pain worse
        during passage of pungent smelling urine.



Back.--  Pain in region of kidneys; better lying bent backward.
        General fatigue.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Apocyn; Ars;
        Coffea   (similar botanically and in relieving effects of fatigue)



Dose.--  Third potency or lower.
